title: Hand-care product specifications as stated by manufacturers: heated hand massagers and adjacent products (Oct 2026)
description: A table of what 16 manufacturers state on their own web pages about 19 products and their return terms: 11 heated hand massagers plus 8 adjacent hand and wrist products (3 compression gloves, 3 wrist braces, 2 paraffin baths). 41 distinct fields (heat, battery, auto shut-off, charging, controls, price, return window, return shipping, restocking fee, warranty and more), each cell marked stated, not-stated, conflict or inaccessible and backed by a verbatim quote from the manufacturer's page. Pages were read on 2026-10-18. Claims quoted are the manufacturers', not ours. This dataset makes no medical claims. Compiled by Wearmelly. We sell Melly, a heated hand massager (wearmelly.com); Melly is not included in this dataset.
